_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Stars, forks and language are pulled live on every run; the description here overrides whatever the repo's GitHub description says.

projects.title: Project Network Analyzer
projects.description: Models a project plan as a directed acyclic graph, computes the critical path, and hands the result to a hybrid agent - deterministic rules plus an LLM - that explains the schedule in plain language.

projects.title: SIGCAP Backend
projects.description: Backend prototype built as a study of software architecture: ten design patterns applied deliberately, each one solving a problem the codebase actually had.

projects.title: ForoHub API
projects.description: RESTful discussion-forum API in Spring Boot with JWT authentication, validation and persistence. The closest thing here to production backend work.

projects.title: Search Algorithm Simulator
projects.description: Interactive visualiser for classic search algorithms, built to make the cost difference between them something you can watch rather than just read about.
